app.name: RCONductor
app.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
app.later: This page follows in a later step.

login.title: Sign in
login.locked: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
login.busy: The panel is busy. Please try again in a moment.

password.title: Choose a new password
password.explain: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
password.failed: The password was not changed. Check the current password.

nav.theme: Switch between dark and light design
nav.label: Main navigation

health.label: Health
health.restartLoop: restarts again and again (3 or more starts in 10 minutes)

actions.label: Server actions
actions.agentGone: The agent is disconnected; actions are not possible.

confirm.stop: The container stops. Players are disconnected; the server stays down until it is started again.
confirm.restart: The container restarts. Players are disconnected for a moment.
confirm.rcon: The server is stopped with its stop command. It starts again only if a restart mechanism applies (for example Docker restart: always or unless-stopped; on-failure does not apply to a clean shutdown).

error.action_failed: The agent or Docker refused the action.
error.rate_limited: Too many actions. Please wait a moment.
error.timeout: The agent did not answer in time.
error.server_unavailable: The server is not reachable over RCON.

overview.noPlayerList: The game profile has no player list.

history.title: History
history.ownOnly: You see your own commands only.
history.truncated: The answer was cut at 64 KiB.

console.hint: Tab takes the first suggestion · arrow keys walk your own commands

commands.none: There are no commands for you on this server.
commands.pick: Put the name into the player field
commands.pickHint: Click a player field, then a name

reason.wrapper_blocked: This command is blocked for your role
reason.rate_limited: Too many commands. Please wait a moment.
reason.rate_limited_wait: Too many commands. Try again in {{s}} s.
reason.invalid: The command does not fit its fields
reason.timeout: The server did not answer in time

logs.agentGone: The agent is disconnected; no new lines arrive.
logs.rateLimited: Too many requests for this container. Try again in {{s}} s.
logs.failed: The earlier lines could not be read.

invite.title: Accept the invitation
invite.explain: Choose your pseudonym and password. Others see you by your pseudonym.
invite.done: Your account is ready. Sign in with your pseudonym and password.
invite.noToken: This link holds no invitation. Open the link you got once more.
invite.expired: This invitation is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new link.
invite.rejected: The pseudonym is taken or not allowed. Choose another one.

undo.leaveText: Your changes here are not saved yet and will be lost.

admin.phoneReadOnly: Read-only on a phone. Use a larger screen to make changes.
admin.phoneReadOnlyUsers: Read-only on a phone, apart from locking, unlocking and ending sessions. Use a larger screen for other changes.
admin.lockText: This user can no longer sign in and open sessions end.
admin.unlockText: This user can sign in again.
admin.sessionsText: This user is signed out everywhere and has to sign in again.

reason.not_found: Not found or not managed by you
reason.rate_limited: Too many changes, try again shortly
reason.busy: The panel is busy, try again

admin.removeText: The users lose their access and assignments at once. This cannot be undone.
admin.supportersAllowedHint: Only passable commands of the own list
admin.resetText: A temporary password replaces the current one; all sessions of the user end. You see it only once.
admin.roleWarning: Assignments of the old role will be removed; sessions end.

undo.sessionsEnded: assignments of {{name}}. The sessions of this user ended; Undo brings back the rights, not the sessions

invite.title: Create invitation link
invite.explain: The invited person chooses pseudonym and password. A template passes on rights and assignments.
invite.once: This link is shown only now. It holds the invitation in its fragment.

lists.name: Name
lists.explain: A command path allows whole tokens and everything after them (CMD-004). Passable commands can be given to supporters.
lists.oneLocked: At least one command must stay locked for supporters. Not saved.
lists.deleteText: Moderator groups with this list lose their commands at once. This cannot be undone.

groups.name: Name
groups.deleteText: Its members lose the servers and commands of this group at once. This cannot be undone.

testResult.ok: Connection works: the game server accepted the password.
testResult.auth_failed: The game server refused the password.
testResult.unreachable: The game server cannot be reached at this address.

servers.deleteText: Its history stays in the audit; groups and grants lose it at once. This cannot be undone.
servers.name: Name
servers.agentAway: The agent is disconnected; the containers are the last known ones.
servers.ownPorts: Own game ports instead of the profile's
servers.newGroupName: Name of a new server group
servers.deleteGroupText: Grants and scopes on this group end at once; the servers stay. This cannot be undone.
servers.explainAdmin: Create servers, set agent and container, form server groups.
servers.explainRead: The servers and server groups of your scope, read only.

credentials.missing: No RCON password stored. Enter one.
credentials.reenter: The RCON password was stored with another master key. Enter it again.

agents.pairExplain: Make a one-time token. The Compose service below starts the agent on the game host with it.
agents.once: The token is in this service and shown only now; it is valid once for 24 hours.
agents.fingerprintHint: Off by default. Waiting agents appear below to approve; it switches itself off after 30 minutes.
agents.name: Name
agents.revokeText: The agent loses its connection at once; servers on it lose agent and container. This cannot be undone.

settings.explain: Global settings of the panel (Design 5.6). Changes wait a few seconds for Undo.
settings.supportersOffText: All supporters lose their access and their sessions end at once.

backup_interval.label: Backup interval
backup_interval.help: How often the panel makes a backup of its database.

backup_keep_auto.label: Automatic backups kept
backup_keep_auto.help: How many regular backups stay; older ones are removed.

backup_keep_pre_migration.label: Backups before updates kept
backup_keep_pre_migration.help: Backups made before a database update that stay.

session_idle_timeout.label: Session idle time
session_idle_timeout.help: A session without activity ends after this time.

session_max_lifetime.label: Session lifetime
session_max_lifetime.help: A session ends after this time at the latest.

login_max_failures.label: Failed sign-ins before lock
login_max_failures.help: Wrong passwords per account and address before a lock.

login_max_client_failures.label: Failed sign-ins per address
login_max_client_failures.help: Failures from one address, over all names, before it is locked. People behind one address share this count.

login_max_tracked.label: Sign-in counters in memory
login_max_tracked.help: When they run out, sign-ins not yet counted wait in one line.

login_lockout_duration.label: Lock after failed sign-ins
login_lockout_duration.help: How long sign-in stays locked after too many failures.

invite_lifetime.label: Invitation lifetime
invite_lifetime.help: How long an invitation link can be used.

supporters_enabled.label: Supporters
supporters_enabled.help: Moderators may have supporters. Off ends all supporter sessions.

audit_retention_days.label: Audit retention (days)
audit_retention_days.help: Audit entries older than this are removed.

ws_max_sockets_per_session.label: Live connections per session
ws_max_sockets_per_session.help: Above this the oldest connection of a session closes.

ws_max_subscriptions_per_socket.label: Subscriptions per connection
ws_max_subscriptions_per_socket.help: Live topics one browser tab may follow at once.

servers_connection_test_per_minute.label: Connection tests per minute
servers_connection_test_per_minute.help: How often one user may test RCON data in the server dialog.

profiles_poll_interval.label: Game profile check
profiles_poll_interval.help: How often the panel looks for changed profile files.

agents_fingerprint_pairing.label: Pairing by fingerprint
agents_fingerprint_pairing.help: Waiting agents can be approved; switches itself off after 30 minutes.

ui_shortcuts_enabled.label: Keyboard shortcuts
ui_shortcuts_enabled.help: Single keys for frequent actions, for everyone.

ratelimit_per_minute.label: Commands per minute: {{role}}
ratelimit_per_minute.help: Rate limit per user and server.

ratelimit_burst.label: Commands in a row: {{role}}
ratelimit_burst.help: How many may come at once before the limit.

settings.badDuration: Use a number and h, min or s, e.g. 72 h.

audit.explain: Who did what and when. Server admins see their scope.

profile.explain: Others see you by your pseudonym; real name, picture and contacts only those who manage you.
profile.pictureRefused: The picture was refused. Use a small PNG or JPEG.
profile.passwordHint: Your other sessions end when the password changes.
